rationale: VERX gapped up ~14% on strong Q3 earnings but is now trading well below VWAP ($17.66) and the 9-EMA ($17.56), sitting at only 23.6% of today's range with a clear downward drift in the last five 1-minute candles — suggesting the gap is fading.
